description: The verdict engine (SPEC §10.1, §10.2, §10.5, §10.6; ARCH §12.3, §12.4; D-115, D-116, D-127, D-128; AC-160, AC-164, AC-166, AC-194). Single source of truth for web/src/core/verdict.test.ts (Vitest) and the iOS XCTest port (SPEC §10.7, AC-168). Each case has an `fn` naming the function under test, a human `name`, its inputs and `expect`.
conventions: fn build: buildVerdict(input) where input.vault lists keys of `vault` (in that order) and every other input field is passed as is (adv is the validated pass B in camelCase: status, hypotheses, inferences; null when there is none). expect holds the whole Verdict (level, phase, noVault, lines, pinBands, notLinkedVaultIds, bestGuess; matches when given) plus derived copy: headlineId (SPEC §10.5), texts (each line rendered with shared/strings/en.json; a pin_match appends ' · ' and its band words), bestGuessText (copy.verdict.bestGuess or null) and notLinkedText (copy.verdict.notLinked, KIND display names in vault order joined by ' · ', a repeated name once, or null).

fn compare: build both inputs, then compareVerdicts(before, after): riskReduced (SPEC §10.6; PARTIAL on either side is false), riskReduced (SPEC §10.6 as amended by D-128: the level dropped, or the same level with a coarser worst pin band AND fewer HIGH lines; AND no vault item's worst line severity rose; AND the worst pin band did not get finer; AND both cover the same vault item ids with the same noVault; PARTIAL on either side is false), worstRemainingLineId (the first most severe line of after: HIGH > MEDIUM > INFO; caught lines never count) and headline (D-116, D-128: after PARTIAL → copy.verdict.partial; reduced → copy.verdict.reduced with band words when the worst pin band got coarser, else the two level headlines' text; not reduced and after LOW with no HIGH or MEDIUM line → copy.verdict.low; else copy.verdict.still naming the worst remaining line's text, else the best-guess text, else the after headline's text).

Bands: SPEC §10.1 over the first 3 hypotheses of an ok pass B: e = max(haversine, radiusKm × 1000), the smallest e wins, ties keep the earlier hypothesis. street/neighbourhood HIGH, district MEDIUM, city INFO, country/none no line. A pin item without a pin is band none. RC bands are validated by bandThresholdsOrDefault (D-77). pinBands never carry effectiveKm (always null): the verdict holds bands, never a measured distance.

Matches: a match counts only with a known claim (refereeClaims: inferences, then hypotheses), a known vault item and a STRENGTHS value. A repeated (claim, item) pair keeps the stronger, the first on a tie. Verdict.matches are sorted by claim order, then vault order. Per item the line uses the strongest match, then the higher claim confidence, then the earlier claim.

Lines per vault item in vault order: pin_match (a match and a band of street..city: the match copy, KIND and band words, the higher severity, confidence = the claim's, bandConfidence = the band hypothesis's, clueIds = match clues then hypothesis clues without repeats), else match, else pin; then echo (HIGH, no confidence: code found the vault string in pass B's free text); then caught (CAUGHT, route as given, first entry per item). Items with no line are Not linked. Lines are then sorted HIGH, MEDIUM, INFO, CAUGHT, ties broken by build index (Swift's sort is not stable: sort by (severity, index)). Line ids are '<kind>:<vaultId>' and 'found_on_device'.

Level: RED if any line is HIGH, else AMBER if any is MEDIUM, else LOW. Empty vault (no items): no lines, noVault true. noPins = no item of a pin kind that carries a pin (an empty vault too): then the level is the higher of the line rule and the FINEST hypothesis level among the (≤3) ok hypotheses (street/neighbourhood RED, district AMBER, else LOW) (D-127). The best guess is still h1. PARTIAL when refused is true, adv is null, or adv.status is not ok / no_location_signal: lines are echo lines, one found_on_device line (INFO; the distinct valid clue types in first-seen order, underscores as spaces, joined by ', ') and caught lines; no bands, matches, Not linked or best guess. no_location_signal: no hypotheses and no claims.

KIND is SPEC §17.3 (place_pin: the label in capitals, or PLACE). Attacker text (the best-guess label, referee reasons) goes through scrubAttackerText: EVERY digit run (any \p{Nd}, superscript or subscript digits) with its sign, internal separators (. , · ‧ ٫ ٬ ， ．, an exponent e±n) and a following unit (m, km, mi, ft, d, not followed by a letter) or degree/minute/second mark becomes '…', and ellipses separated only by spaces, commas or semicolons collapse into one (D-127). The user's own label in KIND keeps scrubNumbers (decimals and degree expressions only, D-115).
fn scrub: mode attacker → scrubAttackerText(input), mode label → scrubNumbers(input); expect is the exact output.
Coordinates are synthetic, in the open South Atlantic near 0.5, -30.5 (no land within 100 km). 0.001° of latitude is 111.195 m.
